description: This file defines the IBasketService interface for managing shopping basket operations in the application, including transferring baskets, adding items, setting item quantities, and deleting baskets.

classes.name: IBasketService
classes.description: Interface for basket-related operations in the eShopWeb application.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers a basket from an anonymous ID to a user account.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to a user's basket.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Sets quantities for multiple items in a basket.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket by its ID.
